title: Pools: live
description: What are the followed pools doing right now? Kept current from the local node by the watcher (lpbot watch-pools): price, liquidity, volume and fees minute by minute, the liquidity around the price, recent swaps and every position. Times are UTC.

list.name: pool
list.label: Pool
list.query: select pool as __value, pool_name as __text from live_pools order by tvl_usd desc nulls last
list.definition: select pool as __value, pool_name as __text from live_pools order by tvl_usd desc nulls last

list.name: unit
list.label: Price in
list.query: select price_unit from live_pools where pool = '$pool'
list.definition: select price_unit from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

list.name: sym0
list.label: Token0
list.query: select symbol0 from live_pools where pool = '$pool'
list.definition: select symbol0 from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

list.name: sym1
list.label: Token1
list.query: select symbol1 from live_pools where pool = '$pool'
list.definition: select symbol1 from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

list.name: base
list.label: Base token
list.query: select split_part(price_unit, ' per ', 2) from live_pools where pool = '$pool'
list.definition: select split_part(price_unit, ' per ', 2) from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

list.name: quote
list.label: Quote token
list.query: select split_part(price_unit, ' per ', 1) from live_pools where pool = '$pool'
list.definition: select split_part(price_unit, ' per ', 1) from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.title: Every pool now

targets.rawSql:
select pool_name as "pool", price, price_unit as "price in", tvl_usd as "value held", volume_usd_24h as "volume 24h", fees_usd_24h as "fees 24h", swaps_1h as "swaps 1h", positions_open as "open positions", positions_in_range as "in range", known_share as "liquidity attributed", block, head_block - block as "behind", extract(epoch from now())::bigint - updated as "written", pool
from live_pools order by tvl_usd desc nulls last

panels.description: Every followed pool at the last block applied. Value held is what all positions hold at the price. Liquidity attributed is the share of the active liquidity in positions the service knows: positions nobody touched since the start of the stored history stay unattributed. Behind is blocks behind the node's head; written is seconds since the row was written. Click a pool to show it below.

panels.title: Price, ${unit}

targets.rawSql: select price as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: At the last block applied: the dollar price of the pool's other token, or the quote token per base token without a dollar stable.

panels.title: Value held by positions

targets.rawSql: select tvl_usd as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: What every position in the pool holds at the price, in dollars. Fees earned and not collected are not in it.

panels.title: Volume, last hour

targets.rawSql: select volume_usd_1h as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: Dollars swapped in the last hour, counted on the quote side.

panels.title: Fees, last hour

targets.rawSql: select fees_usd_1h as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: Fees swappers paid in the last hour, in dollars.

panels.title: Volume, 24h

targets.rawSql: select volume_usd_24h as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: Dollars swapped in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Fees, 24h

targets.rawSql: select fees_usd_24h as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: Fees swappers paid in the last 24 hours, in dollars.

panels.title: Swaps, last hour

targets.rawSql: select swaps_1h as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: Swaps in the last hour.

panels.title: Active liquidity

targets.rawSql: select liquidity as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: The pool's liquidity at the current tick, in the pool's own units: what a swap trades against.

panels.title: Open positions

targets.rawSql: select positions_open as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: Positions the service knows that hold liquidity: position NFTs and pool positions of other owners.

panels.title: In range

targets.rawSql: select positions_in_range as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: Of the open positions, those whose range holds the price.

panels.title: Liquidity attributed

targets.rawSql: select known_share as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: Share of the active liquidity in positions the service knows. The rest is in positions nobody touched since the stored history begins.

panels.title: Block

targets.rawSql: select block as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: The last block applied.

panels.title: Block age

targets.rawSql: select extract(epoch from now())::bigint - time as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: How old the last block applied is, by this machine's clock: up to about a block's time (12 seconds) when the node and the service keep up with the chain. It grows when either falls behind, also when the node itself stops getting blocks (no peers, the internet down), which "Blocks behind the head" cannot show: that one counts from the node's own head.

panels.title: Blocks behind the head

targets.rawSql: select head_block - block as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: How far the service is behind the node's head, not the chain's: 0 or 1 when it keeps up; more while it catches up. A node that is itself behind the chain shows 0 here; "Block age" shows it.

panels.title: Written

targets.rawSql: select extract(epoch from now())::bigint - updated as value from live_pools where pool = '$pool'

panels.description: Seconds since the service last wrote this pool's row. Above a minute, it is not writing: see `make watch-logs` on the node machine.

panels.title: Price, ${unit}

targets.rawSql: select to_timestamp(time) as time, close as "price", high, low from live_pool_series where pool = '$pool' and $__unixEpochFilter(time) order by 1

panels.description: Minute by minute, at the close of each minute with activity: the pool price, and the highest and lowest it reached in the minute.

panels.title: Volume per minute

targets.rawSql: select to_timestamp(time) as time, volume_usd as "volume" from live_pool_series where pool = '$pool' and $__unixEpochFilter(time) order by 1

panels.description: Dollars swapped in each minute, counted on the quote side.

panels.title: Active liquidity

targets.rawSql: select to_timestamp(time) as time, liquidity as "active liquidity" from live_pool_series where pool = '$pool' and $__unixEpochFilter(time) order by 1

panels.description: The liquidity at the price at the close of each minute with activity.

panels.title: Fees per minute

targets.rawSql: select to_timestamp(time) as time, fees_usd as "fees" from live_pool_series where pool = '$pool' and $__unixEpochFilter(time) order by 1

panels.description: Fees swappers paid in each minute, in dollars.

panels.title: Swaps, mints and burns per minute

targets.rawSql: select to_timestamp(time) as time, swaps, mints, burns from live_pool_series where pool = '$pool' and $__unixEpochFilter(time) order by 1

panels.description: Events in each minute: swaps, and liquidity put in (mints) and taken out (burns).

panels.title: Liquidity near the price now, in dollars

targets.rawSql:
select round(price_mid::numeric, greatest(0, 5 - floor(log(abs(price_mid)))::int))::text as price, volatile_usd as "held in ${base}", dollar_usd as "held in ${quote}"
from live_liquidity where pool = '$pool' and scope = 'near' order by price_mid

panels.description: What positions hold in each tick spacing around the price, at the last block applied, in dollars, by the token held. The bucket with both colours holds the price.

panels.title: Liquidity around the price now, in dollars

targets.rawSql:
select round(price_mid::numeric, greatest(0, 5 - floor(log(abs(price_mid)))::int))::text as price, volatile_usd as "held in ${base}", dollar_usd as "held in ${quote}"
from live_liquidity where pool = '$pool' and scope = 'wide' order by price_mid

panels.description: The same, 20% either side of the price in 0.5% buckets (stablecoin pairs: 0.5% in 0.01% buckets).

panels.title: Open positions

targets.rawSql: select kind, token_id as "NFT", owner, price_low as "from", price_high as "to", in_range as "in range", share as "share of active", value_usd as "value", amount0 as "${sym0}", amount1 as "${sym1}", owed_usd as "to collect", fees_usd as "fees earned", collected0 as "collected ${sym0}", collected1 as "collected ${sym1}", to_timestamp(opened_time) as "opened", to_timestamp(changed_time) as "last change", position_id from live_positions where pool = '$pool' and status = 'open' order by value_usd desc nulls last limit 500

panels.description: Every position the service knows that holds liquidity, largest first (at most 500): position NFTs, with their holder, and pool positions of other owners (vaults, bots). The range is in the price unit. Value is what it holds at the price; to collect is what its owner could collect now, fees and taken-out principal; fees earned counts from when the service started following it. Opened is empty for a position that held liquidity before the stored history began.

panels.title: Recent swaps

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(time) as time, side, amount0 as "${sym0}", amount1 as "${sym1}", price, volume_usd as "value", fee_usd as "fee", block, tx_hash as "transaction", sender, recipient
from live_swaps where pool = '$pool' and $__unixEpochFilter(time) order by block desc, log_index desc limit 300

panels.description: The last swaps in the time range (at most 300), newest first. Amounts are what the pool received (positive) or paid out (negative). Side is buy when the swapper took ${base} out. The sender is usually a router; the transaction shows who sent it.

panels.title: Recently closed positions

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(closed_time) as "closed", kind, token_id as "NFT", owner, price_low as "from", price_high as "to", in_range as "in range", share as "share of active", value_usd as "value", amount0 as "${sym0}", amount1 as "${sym1}", owed_usd as "to collect", fees_usd as "fees earned", collected0 as "collected ${sym0}", collected1 as "collected ${sym1}", to_timestamp(opened_time) as "opened", position_id, deposited0 as "put in ${sym0}", deposited1 as "put in ${sym1}", withdrawn0 as "taken out ${sym0}", withdrawn1 as "taken out ${sym1}", closed_time - opened_time as "held"
from live_positions where pool = '$pool' and status = 'closed' and $__unixEpochFilter(closed_time) order by closed_time desc limit 300

panels.description: Positions whose liquidity was taken out in the time range, newest first (at most 300). Many are held for a single block: liquidity put in around one large swap and taken out again. Held is how long it held liquidity.
